description: This file defines a helper class for parsing HTML and converting it into a RichText object in the PhpSpreadsheet library. It handles HTML tags like <b>, <i>, <font>, etc., and manages styles such as color, font, size, and text decorations.

classes.name: Html
classes.description: A helper class for converting HTML strings into PhpSpreadsheet RichText objects, with support for common styling tags and color mapping.

methods.name: toRichTextObject
methods.description: Parses an HTML string and converts it into a RichText object, applying styles based on HTML tags.

methods.name: colourNameLookup
methods.description: Returns the hexadecimal color code associated with a CSS color name.
